result.summary: Analysis of the interface reveals minor content and layout inconsistencies.

issues.description: The search placeholder contains a typo: 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling in the search bar text.

issues.description: Text truncation occurs for restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Optimize label spacing or implement text wrapping.

issues.description: Delivery time badges obscure significant portions of the product imagery.
issues.suggestion: Reposition badges to improve visual clarity of the food.
